current.thesis: MCX Crude will break below ₹7,050 support by MCX close today, unable to hold as OPEC supply fears persist.
current.reasoning: ₹7,050 is the only meaningful intraday floor before the psychologically critical ₹7,000 handle; breach signals continuation of the ₹1,300 gap below the 20-SMA, confirming OPEC production-hike repricing.

yesterday.thesis: MCX Gold will not hold above ₹153,161 by MCX close today as rupee strength continues to offset COMEX overnight gains.
yesterday.reasoning: Resistance at ₹153,161 is being tested against cross-currents: while COMEX Gold rose 0.37% overnight, the rupee's 0.49% strengthening to ₹94.64 has compressed the translation gain into near-flat opening price action, signaling sellers will defend this level as the structural support from COMEX gains dissipates.

history.thesis: MCX Crude will break below ₹7,610 by MCX close today as the risk-off sentiment that drove the overnight 5.56% rout remains intact with no structural support visible.
history.reasoning: ₹7,610 is the only identified support level and the day's low; with the 20-SMA at ₹8,583 now 12.5% above price and no intermediate resistance named, a break below this level signals capitulation in the crude selloff.
